title: Cyber Mouse Crystal Cascade
description: A brown mouse wearing intricate golden cybernetic armor and a glowing blue visor sits on an icy crystal ledge. Behind it, a towering crystalline mountain emits bright yellow and purple laser beams into a dark purple sky while waterfalls of glowing liquid cascade down its facets.
prompt: A highly detailed brown mouse in ornate golden cybernetic armor with glowing blue visor and antenna, sitting on a crystal ledge holding a staff. Massive translucent crystal mountain with glowing waterfalls and gears embedded in the rock, shooting bright yellow and purple laser beams into a dark purple and yellow nebula sky, iridescent reflections, magical and futuristic atmosphere.
